line: This document updates [RFC6241] in order to enable NETCONF clients to interact with all the datastores supported by a server implementing the NMDA.  The update both adds new <get-data> and <edit-data> operations and augments existing <lock>, <unlock>, and <validate> operations.

message: Wordy phrase found: "in order to". Replace it with direct wording.
line: This document also updates [RFC7950] in order to enable NETCONF clients to both discover which datastores are supported by the NETCONF server and determine which modules are supported in each datastore.  The update requires NETCONF servers implementing the NMDA to support the YANG library [RFC8525].
